fields.help: The account this key acts as; leave it empty and the server fills the signed-in caller, while naming another user is refused.
fields.name: user

fields.help: A label to tell your keys apart, up to 200 characters, stored trimmed; it may be renamed later.
fields.name: name

fields.help: The key's level, per workspace role tier: read only reads; write also creates, edits, trashes work; manage also changes settings, invitations and members and purges trash; own also changes roles, hands over and deletes workspaces and accepts invitations. Capped by the user's role; fixed at create.
fields.name: scope

fields.help: A fingerprint of the key, filled by the server and never shown to clients; a value sent at create is replaced, a client's later change is refused, and a sign-in's refresh replaces it.
fields.name: key_hash

fields.help: When the key stops working, or empty for a key that never expires; a client sets it only at create, and a sign-in's refresh moves it forward.
fields.name: expires

fields.help: Set to true to switch the key off for good; a revoked key cannot be switched back on.
fields.name: revoked

fields.help: The app a sign-in minted this key for, or empty for a key minted by hand; set by the server, and a later change is refused.
fields.name: client_id

fields.help: A fingerprint of the sign-in's current refresh token, filled by the server and never shown to clients.
fields.name: refresh_hash

fields.help: When the sign-in's current refresh token stops working; set by the server.
fields.name: refresh_expires

fields.help: A fingerprint of the refresh token the current one replaced, kept so a replayed token ends the sign-in.
fields.name: refresh_prev_hash

fields.help: Which part of the tracker the key reaches: all for every workspace its user belongs to, workspace for one workspace, projects for some projects of one workspace; empty on keys made before reach existed, which reach every workspace. Chosen at create and fixed afterwards.
fields.name: reach

fields.help: The one workspace a key limited to a workspace or to projects reaches, empty for a key that reaches every workspace; deleting the workspace for good deletes the key. Chosen at create and fixed afterwards.
fields.name: workspace

fields.help: The projects a key limited to projects reaches, all in its workspace; a project deleted for good drops out of the list. Chosen at create and fixed afterwards.
fields.name: projects

fields.help: Whether this key may list and revoke its user's keys; it can never mint one. Set by sign-in through tm login or by a superuser at create; a create value from anyone else is replaced with false, and a later change is refused.
fields.name: manage_keys

fields.help: When the key last authenticated a request, written at most once a minute, or empty if never; set by the server only.
fields.name: last_used
